Professional Claims Workflow

How Our Partnership Works

Six clear steps, from the first referral through the return of belongings. Select a step to see the details.

  1. 01Submit a Claim or Referral

    Contact ACR at any time with the property loss details and the names of the adjuster or restoration contractor. ACR coordinates the next steps with the appropriate parties.

  2. 02Damage Assessment

    The affected clothing, garments, and textiles are reviewed by material, condition, damage type, and restoration potential.

  3. 03Inventory & Estimate

    ACR prepares itemized inventories, supporting photographs, and written restoration estimates, including Xactimate-based assignments or estimates.

  4. 04Pickup & Restoration

    ACR provides free pickup, professional textile restoration, off-site storage, and emergency turnaround for essential clothing when needed.

  5. 05Communication & Coordination

    ACR works with insurance adjusters and restoration contractors as the work progresses and coordinates the authorized scope and return arrangements.

  6. 06Delivery & Billing

    Restored belongings are returned on a scheduled basis. ACR provides closeout details and bills insurance carriers directly when authorized. Coverage and payment depend on the applicable policy and claim approval.

Have a new assignment? Contact ACR to coordinate the next steps.

Professional Questions

Answers for Claims and Restoration Teams.

Details commonly needed before assigning textile restoration work. Job-specific requirements are coordinated with ACR.

For Adjusters & Carriers

Can ACR work from an Xactimate assignment?

Yes. ACR accepts Xactimate-based assignments and estimates, and prepares written estimates with itemized inventories and supporting photographs.

Does ACR bill the insurance carrier directly?

Yes, when authorized. Direct billing does not independently establish policy coverage or guarantee payment; coverage and approvals remain with the insurer.

Does ACR already work with insurance and contractor vendor programs?

Yes. ACR has existing carrier and contractor vendor agreements. Contact ACR to confirm the arrangements applicable to a particular assignment; no carrier-specific affiliation is implied.

What happens when some items cannot be restored?

Affected items are assessed individually. Certain heat, material, or contamination damage may make restoration impractical. ACR can document item condition for claim review without making coverage or settlement decisions.

For Restoration Contractors

Can ACR coordinate textile pickup while structural work continues?

Yes. ACR offers free pickup and works with restoration contractors to coordinate textile handling and return arrangements alongside the property's restoration.

What if the policyholder urgently needs everyday clothing?

ACR offers emergency essential-clothing turnaround. Priority items and actual return arrangements should be discussed for each loss; no fixed turnaround is promised.

Can clothing and textiles stay in storage during repairs?

Yes. ACR provides off-site storage and scheduled return. Timing and handling arrangements can be coordinated for the individual project.

How do we start a new professional assignment without an online form?

Call ACR at 717-738-2679. The team is available 24/7 for inquiries. Share the loss details and the adjuster or contractor contacts needed to coordinate the next steps.
